items.title: George Shearing interviewed by Joe Williams, New York City, New York, March 8, 1996
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Oh, boy. And I remember one day Max said to me... [INTERVIEWEE] One was out there. One was in front of the bar.

ctx.x: Oh, boy. And I remember one day Max said to me, “I want to play something, you tell me where one is.” [scats]. I said, “How’s that again?” [scats]. He says, “One” [scats] — “one” [scats]. © Fillius Jazz Archive -5-
One was out there. One was in front of the bar. “One” [scats].
